The '''Vandron system''' lay in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[D'Aelgoth sector/Legends|D'Aelgoth sector]]. It was run by a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]&ndash;affiliated [[Vandronian government|government]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Riggins Delahrg]], the former Imperial [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tallaso]], became employed at the [[Imperial Administration building]] of the Vandron [[Star system/Legends|system]]. Delarhg fled when the Vandronian government collapsed mere [[Standard month/Legends|months]] later.

==Description==
The Vandron system was located in the [[D'Aelgoth sector/Legends|D'Aelgoth sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

==History==
The Vandron [[Star system/Legends|system]] shared its name with [[Thull Vandron]], a [[Currency/Legends|wealthy]] entrepreneur from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Axum]] who spearheaded the [[Colonist/Legends|settlement]] of the Mid Rim's [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in around [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], as well as [[House Vandron]], one of the [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] [[Ancient Houses]] that eventually came to rule the Senex-Juvex.<ref name="TEA" />

Following the fragmentation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="Heroes" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the Vandron system became the closest system to the planet [[Tallaso]]<ref name="Heroes" /> of the D'Aelgoth [[Sector/Legends|sector]]<ref name="EAOC Tallaso">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Tallaso system/Legends|Tallaso system]]</ref> to host a functioning Imperial [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucracy]]. When the ousted Imperial [[Governor/Legends|governor]] [[Riggins Delahrg]] of Tallaso traveled to the Vandron system in search of employment, he walked into the system's [[Imperial Administration building]] and [[Con artist/Legends|bluffed]] his way into a well-paying position. Less than six [[Standard month/Legends|months]] later, the [[Vandronian government]] collapsed, and Delarhg, unemployed again, fled the system.<ref name="Heroes" />

==Inhabitants==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Vandron system was under the control of a local government that was affiliated with the Galactic Empire.<ref name="Heroes" />

==Locations==
The Imperial Administration building was located in the Vandron system.<ref name="Heroes" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Vandron system was first mentioned in the [[1995]] [[West End Games]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement ''[[Heroes & Rogues]]'', which was written by [[Paul Sudlow]] and [[Rick D. Stuart|Rick Stuart]].<ref name="Heroes" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square L-17.<ref name="TEA" />
